title: Power supplies and schematic symbols
blurb: Explain what each stage of a power supply does, compare rectifier types, and read the symbols in figure G7-1.

G7A01.why: Filter capacitors can hold a dangerous charge. The **bleeder resistor** discharges them when power is removed.
G7A01.trap: A fuse protects against overcurrent. A bleeder is not a fuse or a ground-loop cure.

G7A02.why: The filter smooths rectified pulses using **capacitors and inductors**.
G7A02.trap: Diodes rectify and transformers change voltage. Neither filters.

G7A03.why: Two diodes and a **center-tapped** transformer make a **full-wave** rectifier. One diode each takes a half cycle.
G7A03.trap: A bridge uses four diodes and no center tap.

G7A04.why: A half-wave rectifier passes one half of the cycle, so it needs **only one diode**.
G7A04.trap: Half-wave ripple is at the AC frequency, which is half the full-wave rate. It gives less current, not more.

G7A05.why: A half-wave rectifier uses one half of the AC cycle: **180°**.
G7A05.trap: 360° is the whole cycle, which a full-wave rectifier uses.

G7A06.why: A full-wave rectifier uses both halves: the whole **360°** cycle.

G7A07.why: Full-wave output is DC pulses, **two per AC cycle**, so at twice the AC frequency.
G7A07.trap: Smooth DC only appears after the filter.

G7A08.why: Switchmode supplies work at high frequency, so transformers and filter parts can be **smaller**.
G7A08.trap: Switchmodes are usually more complex than linear supplies, not simpler.

G7A09.why: A circle with a channel bar and an arrowed gate lead is a **FET**: symbol 1.
G7A09.trap: Symbol 2 has a base lead and emitter arrow: a bipolar transistor.

G7A10.why: A diode whose bar has **bent ends** is a **Zener** diode: symbol 5.
G7A10.trap: Symbol 4 is a varactor with a curved plate.

G7A11.why: A bipolar transistor with an emitter arrow pointing **out** is **NPN**: symbol 2.

G7A12.why: Two coils with **bars between** them are a transformer with a solid core: symbol 6.

G7A13.why: A single coil with a **tap wire** off it is a tapped inductor: symbol 7.
G7A13.trap: Symbol 6 has two coils: a transformer.
